name: Is it better to hire a specialist for trim repair or a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to hire a specialist for trim repair or a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: For trim repair, a general contractor like City Dweller, LLC often provides a more comprehensive service than a specialist. While a trim specialist focuses solely on trim, a general contractor can also identify and address any underlying issues that caused the trim damage, such as water leaks, structural problems, or pest infestations. This holistic approach ensures not just the repair of the trim itself but also the prevention of future recurrence, providing a more robust and lasting solution for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor is often better for trim repair as they can address underlying issues causing the damage, offering a more comprehensive and lasting solution than a trim specialist.
